PREMIERE316 STYLE-ONLY IMAGE REFERENCE CONTROL — V2
Asset ID: atmosphere-shattered-gate-fragments-action-effect-variation-1
Workflow profile: 2P39X1 (2.39:1)
Reference mode: ART DIRECTION ONLY — NO SUBJECT OR DESIGN TRANSFER.

The loaded images are non-content style plates. The asset prompt below is the sole authority for subject, identity, age, ethnicity, anatomy, wardrobe design, prop design, environment geometry, creatures, crowd population, pose, action, camera composition, wounds, blood placement, text, and all story content.

ALLOWED TRANSFER ONLY: overall palette; contrast curve; key/fill/rim relationship; volumetric-light behavior; atmosphere density; material highlight and shadow response; lens/exposure language; practical texture fidelity; cinematic depth; restrained film grain.

FORBIDDEN TRANSFER: faces or facial geometry; body identity or proportions; hairstyles; costume silhouettes; wounds or blood maps; weapons or props; architecture or set geography; creature designs; crowd layout; pose; framing; four-panel layout; lettering; logos; or any recognizable object from a reference, unless the asset prompt itself explicitly requests that exact element.

Atmosphere/VFX guard: transfer only light falloff, particle behavior, haze density, ember/gold color relationships, and cinematic exposure. Keep the effect content and compositing requirements controlled by this row.

Active plate roles: warm-gold lighting and highlight rolloff; smoky umber shadow palette and ember atmosphere; abstract filmic tonal/material response and restrained grain.
When a reference conflicts with the row prompt, ignore the reference and obey the row prompt.

AUTHORITATIVE ASSET PROMPT
--------------------------
SHATTERED GATE FRAGMENTS - ACTION EFFECT — VARIATION 1: CINEMATIC VFX, PARTICLES, LIGHT, TRANSFORMATION, AND MOTION REFERENCE.

Photorealistic live-action production reference, physically coherent lighting, exact anatomy, clean hands, consistent scale and materials, no captions, no logos, no watermarks, no borders, and no written or graphical elements.

Cinematic freeze-frame action effect of Hell's Gate mid-shatter at the exact instant Jesus speaks the single word Open. The subject is not a character but the catastrophic debris field of the fortress doors themselves: a 100-foot-tall by 60-foot-wide double gate of fused black iron and bone exploding outward into the abyss hall in a radial storm of molten and semi-molten fragments. Colossal jagged slabs of corroded iron plate tumble through air, edges white-hot and still cooling through cherry red into dull ember glow. Interleaved with the metal are splintered lengths of fused bone—rib curves, femur shafts, and skull-plate sections that once formed the damned-face carvings on the gate surface—now broken free and spinning as discrete wreckage. Several mid-air shards still carry partial carved faces of the damned, mouths locked open mid-scream, their iron-and-bone features split down the center with golden fracture light bleeding from the cracks. Spiderweb fracture lines remaining on larger panels glow from within with pure divine fire, the same inner radiance that began as hairline cracks when the wounded hand pressed the cold metal.

Debris scale ranges from house-sized door panels to fist-sized scrap and a dense cloud of glowing micro-shards, sparks, and black ash. Motion is captured as a dramatic freeze-frame: larger fragments trail motion-blur streaks of molten orange and gold; finer particles hang like a constellation of fire. Trajectory radiates outward and slightly upward from the former door plane toward the camera and the fortress flanks, conveying absolute force without chaos for its own sake—divine power tearing the prison open rather than random demolition. Corroded bronze fittings, hinge remnants, and dried-blood-stained iron bolts spin among the wreckage, material continuity locked to the established gate construction of iron-and-bone fusion with bronze accents and ancient blood staining.

Environment is INT. HELL'S FORTRESS at the gate threshold: black stone pillars and floor partially visible at frame edges and background, ceiling lost in smoke, blue torches still burning on flanking walls so residual cold blue torch light ~2000K rakes the undersides of falling fragments while the dominant key is the blinding golden divine radiance flooding through the new breach from behind and through the debris field. Volumetric god rays at ~6500K cut through ash and smoke, rim-lighting every shard with ethereal gold (#FFD700) and warm amber (#FFBF00). Red underglow from residual hell fire reflects faintly on the darkest iron undersides. Color grade holds deep crimson (#8B0000) and obsidian black (#0A0A0A) fortress context colliding with pure white-gold divine intrusion; mixed temperature contrast is intentional and physically coherent—cold blue fill from torches, hot gold key from the breach.

Camera: ultra-wide 24mm cinematic lens, low three-quarter angle looking slightly upward into the expanding debris sphere to emphasize colossal scale; 2.39:1 widescreen composition; deep focus so near fragments stay sharp while distant wreckage and pillars fall into atmospheric haze; slight anamorphic-style horizontal lens flare from the central light flood, no modern camera branding. Texture density is extreme: pitted corrosion, heat-scaling, molten drip strands mid-air, bone grain and porous marrow interiors exposed on broken ends, ash powder and smoke swirls catching rim light. Atmosphere includes thick black smoke, rising heat shimmer, and ash particles illuminated gold as light conquers darkness.

Optional distant silhouettes of towering guardians may appear only as soft background shapes being thrown backward with armor cracking, already dissolving at edges into smoke and ash—never dominant, never readable modern armor. No full hero figure required; the gate wreckage is the hero subject. Continuity locks: gate materials always iron fused with bone; fracture glow is divine gold not generic lava; hell torches remain blue until later transformation; sacred biblical-epic tone, triumph over darkness, not gore spectacle. No modern objects, no logos, no readable text, no watermarks, no UI, no borders, no captions. Photoreal live-action production still, physically coherent materials and lighting, maximum useful detail for VFX plate and atmosphere reference of the shattered-gate explosion beat.
